DESCRIPTION: Monitor game servers, a message with their status updates on its own
EXAMPLES:
gameserver add game:Garry's Mod address:1.2.3.4:27015
gameserver add game:Minecraft address:play.example.com channel:#servers title:Survival
gameserver remove server:Survival
gameserver list
CHANNEL: Where to post the status (this channel by default)
TITLE: Name to show instead of the server's own
INTERVAL: How often to check the server, in minutes (1 by default)
ADDED: Monitoring {{server}}, the status is in {{channel}}. Pick what it shows in the dashboard
EMPTY: No game servers are monitored here yet
